title: Phrases
subtitle: A2 · Unit 3: Everyday events: what I did

steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: Listen once and try to rebuild each chunk from meaning. Write one model in your notes, close them, and retell your own first experience without copying the sample.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.fr: La semaine dernière, j'ai pris le train pour la première fois.
steps.en: Last week, I took the train for the first time.
steps.tip: Say it: lah suh-MEN dehr-NYEHR zhay pree luh tra(n) poor lah pruh-MYEHR fwah

steps.fr: J'ai lu le message avant de partir.
steps.en: I read the message before leaving.
steps.tip: Say it: zhay lü luh meh-SAHZH ah-vah(n) duh pahr-TEER

steps.fr: Ensuite, j'ai pris une correspondance au centre-ville.
steps.en: Then I took a connection downtown.
steps.tip: Say it: ah(n)-SWHEET zhay pree ün koh-rehs-poh(n)-DAH(N)S oh sah(n)tr-VEEL

steps.fr: J'ai vu le numéro sur le billet.
steps.en: I saw the number on the ticket.
steps.tip: Say it: zhay vü luh nü-may-ROH sür luh bee-YAY

steps.fr: J'ai fait une demande à l'accueil.
steps.en: I made a request at the welcome desk.
steps.tip: Say it: zhay feh ün duh-MAH(N)d ah lah-KUHY

steps.fr: À la fin, j'ai eu une réponse claire.
steps.en: In the end, I got a clear answer.
steps.tip: Say it: ah lah fa(n) zhay ü ün ray-POHNS klehr

steps.fr: J'ai essayé une nouvelle activité et j'ai beaucoup appris.
steps.en: I tried a new activity and learned a lot.
steps.tip: Say it: zhay eh-seh-YAY ün noo-VEL ak-tee-vee-TAY eh zhay boh-KOO ah-PREE

steps.fr: Je garde le reçu et je note le numéro du dossier.
steps.en: I keep the receipt and write down the file number.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh gard luh ruh-SÜ eh zhuh noht luh nü-may-ROH dü doh-SYAY
